title: agent sandboxing / Check platform availability
content: ## Check platform availability Check the operating system where commands run against the following prerequisites. For remote sessions, install dependencies and operating system updates on the remote machine, not the machine where you connect to the session. | Platform | Prerequisite | |---|---| | macOS | macOS 15 or later with the built-in Seatbelt facility. No additional sandbox packages. | | glibc-based Linux and WSL2 | `bubblewrap` 0.5.0 or later, `slirp4netns`, util-linux 2.35 or later, and compatible `iptables` tools. See [install missing sandbox dependencies](#install-missing-sandbox-dependencies). | | Windows | Windows 11 with BaseContainer and the required OS capabilities. See the update baselines below. | | Alpine Linux and other musl-based distributions | Sandboxed shell execution is not supported by this runtime. Use a supported glibc-based Linux environment. | WSL version 1 is not supported because it does not provide the Linux kernel features that `bubblewrap` requires. On Windows, the documented update baselines are: * Windows 11 25H2: [KB5124010](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/servicing/os/windows-11/2026/09/kb5124010-windows-11-24h2-25h2-update), build 26200.9550 or later. * Windows 11 26H1: [KB5124006](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/servicing/os/windows-11/2026/09/kb5124006-windows-11-26h1-update), build 28000.3086 or later. > [!NOTE] > Windows support is Experimental. The separate [per-server MCP sandboxing feature](/docs/agents/run/manage-mcp-servers.md#sandbox-mcp-servers) is not available on Windows.
